description_en: Recognizes key fields from used car unified sales invoices, including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, purchaser name, and purchaser ID number, and returns structured output
description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、开票日期、发票金额、购买方名称、购买方身份证号等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-used-car-invoice --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i4/O1CN01NiY6e220zrtvT6dFJ_!!6000000006921-0-tps-3468-4624.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeUsedCarInvoice
